# fuzz_script batch: signature checks only -- DER encoding, genuine
# verification failures, ECDSA/Schnorr confusion, point/scalar negation,
# out-of-range values, pubkey encodings, hashtypes, NULLFAIL/multisig.
# Valid baselines are real signatures over CHECKDATASIG messages; each
# failure is derived from them.
#
# One Script program per line in ParseScript mnemonic form; the "#" comment
# directly above a program names it; "<empty>" is the empty script. See
# contrib/fuzz/fuzz_script/fuzz_script_pool.py for the full format.
